Feel free to drag and drop me anywhere you like on your page. I’m a great place for you to tell a story and let your users know a little more about you. Hva er IndiGoBoom? Indigoboom er en norsk digital musikkdistributør for artister og band som vil gi ut musikken sin selv. Kort forklart betyr dette at dersom du har musikk du vil ha ut på Spotify, TIDAL, Apple, TikTok og alle de andre, kan du registrere deg hos oss, laste opp musikkfiler og coverbilde, så sørger vi for at musikken din blir tilgjengelig der du ønsker og utbetaler royalties for salg til deg/dere. Hvem er IndigoBoom? Indigoboom ble startet i 2011 og ble i 2014 et selskap i mediehuset Skyskraper. Vi har langt over hundretusen titler ute på de digitale tjenestene. Titlene omfavner mange ulike genre.Vi jobber med alt fra helt ferske

sources.text: Cases Space Object Program Practice Big picture People Scenario Form Studio Profile Practice Publications Academia Honors Contact English Français Norsk Irregular Notes Big picture People Scenario Form Space Object Program Profile Practice Publications Academia Honors Contact Crafting privacy Represented by GOOD Murmur collection Floor modules - Grounded, Hovering Table module - Modesty Ceiling lighting - Elevated Open space divider made with ash wood, textile and metal Exhibition Norwegian Presence - Milan Open workspaces are adaptive, social and space efficient, perfect for creative sharing and social interaction. At the same time many people find these spaces distractive. Objects in living spaces are active agents that can enhance our energy or take it away. The Murmurs are designed to follow our activity patterns and create a healthy and friendly environment. Together with Good Design in Marseille - France, we committed to make a collection entirely from fossil-free materials. Co-workers We met people in different kinds of open spaces in Oslo, Marseille, Paris, Amsterdam who shared their thoughts, needs and rituals within their co-working spaces. We tested the first ideas of the Murmur with simple models in co-working spaces in Oslo and Marseille. Out of the observations and feedbacks we discovered three major insights: Living modular rooms give the experience of a new space. Nature and randomness brings life and value to rooms.
